messages:
maya: quick canary results from onboarding r-rank-3b (float16 / int8) — focused on embed/rerank throughput across regions. ran batch sweep (bs=1,8,64) and dims 768/1536. posting highlights + commands below.

benchbot: job 2026-03-18-17:21 completed. summary attached. logs: s3://bench-outputs/1823456789.tar.gz :thumbsup:

maya: topline (per-query latency, p50 / batch1) — reranker (1536 dim, single-input)
- us-west (A100): 14ms p50
- eu-west (A10G): 28ms p50
- ap-south (V100 older): 65ms p50

alex: those diffs are bigger than I expected for p50 between A100/A10G. what kernel set did you run?

maya: ran two kernel configs: `baseline-cuBLAS` and `fast-fused` (custom fused matmul+attention, flash-attn). `fast-fused` on A100 reduces p50 by ~30%. on A10G the advantage is ~12%.

zheng: noted. also important: sequence length was 64 for reranker runs. if we drop to 32 latency on A10G moves closer to A100 but throughput still lower.

samir: embedding throughput (vectors/sec) summary for dims=768 / bs=64:
- A100 (us-west): 540 qps
- A10G (eu-west): 340 qps
- CPU (64 vCPU, avx512) eu-west: 48 qps

samir: dims=1536 / bs=64 (same model scaled weights)
- A100: 290 qps
- A10G: 180 qps
- CPU: 24 qps

eva: do we have int8 quant results for CPU? we sometimes get big wins there.

benchbot: quant-run-1823456789-int8 complete. artifacts: /quant/int8/1823456789/

maya: int8 on CPU (same 64 vCPU box) for embed dims=768 bs=64: 92 qps (almost 2x vs fp16). but quality dropped a touch on rerank evals (MAP -0.9%), so need eval gating.

alex: good to know. can we get the eval set comparison? link?

maya: put a quick diff in the run artifact: `eval/compare.tsv` — includes MAP/NDCG by query slice. early look: int8 regression concentrated on long-tail queries with numeric tokens.

zheng: kernel notes: on GPU we saw largest perf delta from enabling `kv-cache-packing` + continuous batching. enabling it increased throughput by ~15% on A100, ~8% on A10G. CPU path needs a different packing strategy (we used vectorized GEMM with custom tiling).

samir: region effects: ap-south machines were on older V100 infra and had PCIe gen2 hosts which killed bandwidth — explains the 2x gap vs eu-west A10G. we should avoid scheduling rerank-heavy lanes there for Dedicated until we upgrade instances.

maya: command used for bench (so you can reproduce):
```
./bench_runner --model r-rank-3b --dtype fp16 --kernels fast-fused --seq 64 --dims 1536 --batch-sizes 1,8,64 --region us-west,eu-west,ap-south --out ./out/1823456789
```

alex: thanks. next actions?

maya: short list:
- gate int8 in staging only; run eval slices for numeric-heavy queries (eva can help)
- disable ap-south for reranker scheduling until infra refresh (samir)
- bake fast-fused kernels into canary images for A100 and A10G (zheng)
- add KV-cache packing flag to Dedicated autoscaler config (eng-platform)

eva: I can run the eval slices tonight and push a detailed MAP/NDCG report. will check numeric tokens.

zheng: I'll start creating the fused-kernel package and a small TF/TensorRT fallback for A10G. posting PR once initial CI passes.

samir: I'll tag infra ticket to block rerank tasks in ap-south. also adding a cost note — A100 run cost was ~1.8x A10G but gave ~1.6x throughput for 1536 dims, so unit cost slightly better on A100 for heavy rerank loads.

maya: perfect. if anyone wants raw numbers, grab the tarball from S3 and ping me. closing this thread after eva posts eval results. :white_check_mark:
